intent: Stop Android screen sharing automatically when the current Viewer session ends; preserve stale-session guards and request fresh consent on the next connection.
rollback: Revert the readOfferSdp accessor change and release a higher Android Agent version; retain existing diagnostics and JNI keep rules.

requestReview.reason: Current-session shutdown now also releases local MediaProjection, capture resources and wake lock. The same existing session listeners are removed; no network request, write, timer, or retry is introduced.
requestReview.assumptions: No request lifecycle changes are included.

outcomes.acceptance: Ending the current Viewer session removes Android's screen-sharing indicator and stops capture; a late old-session stop cannot interrupt a new session, and the next connection requests consent again.
boundaries: session-closed snapshot or named stop-stream command
